title: Silver Sky memo given to Moore as a test

tellings.quote: it was part of a project called Silver Sky because the memo was called the Silver Sky memo. He went and checked it out and found out that was BS too.

plain: A memo about a supposed secret project called Silver Sky, set in New Mexico, was handed to a UFO researcher named Bill Moore, and when he checked it out he found it was false, according to the writer Greg Bishop. Bishop tells it on the show as something Moore went through, saying Moore "found out that was BS too", and the story is that the memo was given to him as a test, to see what he would do with a planted document.
